title: A unified testing approach for log-symmetry using Fourier methods
summary: Continuous and strictly positive data that exhibit skewness and outliers frequently arise in many applied disciplines. Log-symmetric distributions provide a flexible framework for modeling such data. In this article, we develop new goodness-of-fit tests for log-symmetric distributions based on a recent characterization. These tests utilize the characteristic function as a novel tool and are constructed using an $L^2$-type weighted distance measure.
